posts.text: Year-to-year variability in the melting of the surface of the Greenland Ice Sheet may not be a harbinger of ice sheet destabilization, according to a study. Variability in the surface mass balance is an expected response to climate warming. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/2qq250ZMEvb

A new #SciencePerspective highlights “blocc” chemistry, a modular approach to building small molecules from standardized chemical building blocks that could make organic synthesis faster, more automated, and accessible to nonspecialists. https://scim.ag/4x6sACB
posts.external_description: A modular synthesis method could broaden the accessibility of chemistry

posts.author_name: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
posts.text: A study using thousands of tree-ring sites around the world suggests that as the climate warms, more trees will experience growth constraints from dryness by 2100, limiting carbon sequestration. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/oI6k50ZMEbn
